text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab and other MPs demand lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- U.N. Security Council says Iraq did not violate sanctions when it flew a plane to Saudi Arabia to transport elderly and sick pilgrims.
- Japan has decided to suspend visit by its senior officials to Iran.
- Iraq celebrates the 1988 liberation of Fao peninsula after a one-year occupation by Iran.
- China ready to ship medicine to Iraq.
- Trade ministry to ferry foodstuffs to markets during the Moslem feast of al-Adha.
- Greece to open its embassy in Baghdad next month.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ, THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- Editorial attacks Arab League Secretary General for anti- Iraq remarks.
